title: Concept: Django SECRET_KEY value served in a response
description: SECRET_KEY is the root of trust for every signed artefact the framework produces. A leaked key means forged session cookies and forged reset tokens, and the framework gives no way to distinguish a forged cookie from a genuine one after the fact.
applicability: Responses that render framework settings, a debug configuration page or a traceback that includes settings.
risk: The caller forges a signed session for an administrator account and signs any other payload the application trusts.
